metadata.research_question: Does adding inter-route local search (or-opt relocation and swap) on top of the Week 4 composite-score + 2-opt method close the medium-scale distance gap against the nearest-customer baseline, without losing feasibility?

tested_method.description: Composite-score greedy with intra-route 2-opt and inter-route local search (or-opt relocation + swap).

C_composite_score.description: Greedy selection that ranks feasible customers by a weighted score of normalized travel distance, due-time urgency, and time-window slack.

B_nearest_customer.description: Choose the feasible customer with shortest current travel distance.

fairness_controls: same Week 3 instance generator, coordinates, and random seeds
same objective definition: total route distance
same EVRP-TW feasibility checker for all methods
same vehicle, battery, charging, and stopping rules
local-search moves accept only feasible, strictly-shorter solutions
Method D reuses Method C's construction and 2-opt unchanged
